plain: The taking away of the right to vote

webster.text: The act of disfranchising, or depriving of the privileges of a free citizen, or of some particular immunity.

example.quote: It might as well be said that all qualifications are disfranchisemts. and that to require the age of 25 years was a disfranchisement.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, August 13, 1787
